an4.267:1.1: [catuhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato …pe…] attanā ca musāvādī hoti, parañca musāvāde samādapeti, musāvāde ca samanuñño hoti, musāvādassa ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho …pe… [yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.] [catūhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato …pe…]
an4.267:2.1: attanā ca musāvādā paṭivirato hoti, parañca musāvādā veramaṇiyā samādapeti, musāvādā veramaṇiyā ca samanuñño hoti, musāvādā veramaṇiyā ca vaṇṇaṃ bhāsati. imehi kho …pe…
